name: Quad chalk
summary: A shared stretch of sidewalk to draw on with chalk: each friend draws in their own color with a face tag on their doodles; pick a stick, drag to draw, undo your last line. Temporary on purpose.
useWhen: a bored or happy group chat moment: 'someone drew a rice cooker on the quad lol'
a shared doodle wall for the group
something creative to do together on a nice day
dontUseWhen: making a sticker or sprite of yourself (use sprite-maker)
a poster or flyer for an event (use party-flyer)
a game with a winner (use a game)

doodles.description: Up to 6 doodles friends already drew, in thousandths of the pavement
